about: The Oklahoma State University Tribal Treaties Database page for each treaty keeps a "Successor in interest (tribes)" list inside an HTML comment: the page no longer displays it, and some lists read "Under review". Names were matched to roster ids by exact name, the band part after " - ", or the parent before it.
